chosen_concept.prompt: An open dockside landing shelter: four sturdy driftwood timber posts on a plank platform, a sloped cream canvas awning roof with teal-striped scalloped edge, rope lashings, a stack of wooden cargo crates and a barrel beneath the roof, a small hanging lantern. Open on all sides. Real size about 4 m x 3 m footprint, 3 m tall. Stylised Palworld/Animo-class game prop concept, one coherent family with Quaternius-style medieval/fantasy wood and stone assets: chunky readable shapes, warm weathered driftwood timber, sun-bleached rope, teal and sea-blue paint accents, cream sailcloth, clean hand-painted PBR finish. Use the attached boards only for palette, mood, maritime timber/stone/blue language and finish quality. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no crimson anywhere. Single isolated object, full object visible, plain neutral light background, no text, no labels, no people, no creatures.
